title: Ferretti Yachts 690
description:
This Ferretti 690 is a highly specified, immaculately presented example of timeless Italian style. Equipped with a gyro stabiliser, she sleeps six in three generous cabins, each with an en-suite bathroom, plus an air-conditioned twin crew cabin.

The vast saloon is perfect for evenings at anchor, while the cockpit and flybridge take care of daytime entertaining. Twin MTU 1,250 HP engines give a top speed of 28 knots. She is lying in Hong Kong.
